segments.he: אָכַל בַּחֲבוּרַת מִצְוָה. אָמַר רַבִּי אֲבָהוּ: אֵינוֹ חַיָּיב עַד שֶׁיֹּאכַל בַּחֲבוּרָה שֶׁכּוּלָּהּ סְרִיקִין.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that if the son «ate» and drank the requisite amounts of meat and wine «with a group» assembled for the performance «of a mitzva,» he does not become liable as a stubborn and rebellious son. «Rabbi Abbahu says: He is not liable unless he eats with a group that is entirely» made up of «idlers.» This seems to indicate that if he eats and drinks in the company of decent people, even if he consumes the required amounts that would otherwise make him liable, he does not become a stubborn and rebellious son.
